note: Judged corpus for TypeSafe Jev with KMP: kmp_curate review (missing relations by kind, distractors, planted bad declarations), the apply pre-write check, and kmp_ask with and without re-ranking. Every expectation was written by a reader before any run; `types` lists the relation types a reader accepts for a pair, in either direction. Scored by `jev_kmp_scorecard` against recorded judgements (crates/kmp-testkit/judged/jev.cassette.json).

entries.text: INC-4711: card payments failed for 40 minutes after the Valkey cluster lost its primary.
The payments API returned HTTP 502 to checkout while the cache failover was in progress.
We will run Valkey with three replicas instead of one so that a failover no longer drops the session cache.
Ana Ruiz reviewed the INC-4711 postmortem and signed it off.
Refunds for the failed card payments are issued automatically within 48 hours.
Deploy 2.4.1 to production is scheduled for Friday.
Deploy 2.4.1 reached production on Friday at 18:00.
Checkout retries a failed card charge twice before showing an error.
From release 2.5, checkout retries a failed card charge once and then asks the customer for another card.
The fraud check runs before the card is authorized.
Card authorization happens first; the fraud check only reviews charges that were already authorized.
Shoppers were unable to complete their purchases that Monday evening.
Office move 2.4.1: the new printers arrive on Friday.
Ana Ruiz is organizing the team lunch on Thursday.
INC-4711 was also the code name of an unrelated marketing campaign in 2024.
Checkout latency p95 was 1.2 s during the Black Friday load test.
The Black Friday load test passed its 1.5 s p95 budget.
Card data is tokenized before it leaves the checkout page.
PCI DSS scope must stay limited to the payment provider.
Release 2.5 removed the legacy PayPal button from checkout.
Checkout shows both the card form and the legacy PayPal button.
The nightly reconciliation job finished without mismatches.
The nightly reconciliation job reported 312 mismatched payouts.
The payments team moved to the fourth floor.
Invoices are generated as PDF only.
From April, invoices are generated as PDF and also sent as e-invoice XML.

relations.why: The measured p95 of 1.2 s is under the 1.5 s budget the load test required.
relations.evidence: Load test report, Black Friday rehearsal.

relations.why: Tokenizing on the page keeps raw card data out of our systems, which is what keeps PCI DSS scope limited to the provider.
Since release 2.5 the legacy PayPal button is gone, so the earlier checkout layout no longer holds.
Both come from the nightly reconciliation job.
Moving to the fourth floor required more cache replicas.
The team lunch triggered the production deployment.
The PDF-only rule replaces the April change.

Las devoluciones se procesan en un plazo de 48 horas.

El límite diario de reembolsos es de 10.000 euros.
No hay límite diario para los reembolsos.

relations.why: Pagar todas las devoluciones en 36 horas cumple el plazo de 48 horas.
Ambas hablan del límite de reembolsos.

precheck.why: The later entry reports that deploy 2.4.1 reached production on the Friday it was scheduled for.
precheck.evidence: Both entries name deploy 2.4.1 and Friday; the second records it in production at 18:00.

precheck.why: One entry says the fraud check runs before authorization; the other says authorization happens first.
precheck.evidence: The two entries give opposite orders for the fraud check and card authorization.

precheck.why: The replicas were chosen because the team moved offices.
Both report INC-4711, the 40-minute card payment failure after the Valkey primary was lost.
precheck.evidence: Same incident id, duration and cause in English and Spanish.
